scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist/client',{recursive:true});fs.mkdirSync('dist/server',{recursive:true});for(const f of ['index.html','app.js','Geist-400.ttf','Geist-500.ttf','Geist-600.ttf','Geist-700.ttf'])fs.copyFileSync(f,'dist/client/'+f);fs.mkdirSync('dist/.openai');fs.copyFileSync('.openai/hosting.json','dist/.openai/hosting.json');fs.writeFileSync('dist/server/index.js','export default { async fetch(request, env) { return env.ASSETS.fetch(request); } };\n')"
